source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary: For each friendly **NECRONS** unit no farther than **6″** from the bearer, its models gain [Feel No Pain](vsdata:core-rule/feel-no-pain) **5+** against [Psychic Attacks](vsdata:core-rule/psychic) and against [mortal wounds](vsdata:core-rule/mortal-wounds).
